site_definition: Nestle R&D centres in France, mapped to LARGE_OFFICE for their knowledge-worker profile rather than their laboratory function.

site_definition: Nestle distribution centres in France - warehousing and onward distribution, distinct from the industrial sites counted as PLANT.

site_definition: A Tesco-operated data centre site in Ireland. The finding counts a satellite IT room in Dublin - equipment inside a building Tesco already occupies, not a separate site.

site_definition: Tesco-operated distribution centres in Ireland. The cited source names one Dublin facility and states no count of them.

Declining leaves Ireland at zero warehouses, which understates it - Tesco Ireland does operate distribution centres. A wrong figure nobody can check is not better than a visible gap.

site_definition: Nestle industrial/manufacturing sites in France. Which legal entities count is the open question: Nestle France SA alone, or every group entity in France including Nestle Waters, Purina and Nespresso.
note: Ruled on the owner's instruction, 2026-10-14: the declared 28 is replaced by 18. The 28 was an apportionment of a published group factory total across ten countries with no French evidence under it, and every source that looked came in below: the Office francais de la biodiversite at 18 (a French government body, 2024), nestle.fr at 13, an aggregator at 12. 18 is the widest SOURCED figure, which is the right perimeter for a group-level case - nestle.fr's 13 counts Nestle France SA narrowly and excludes Waters, Purina and Nespresso.

site_definition: Nestle production sites in Germany, with the same entity-perimeter question as France.

site_definition: Unilever manufacturing sites in Germany. Perimeter question as above: the declared figure is apportioned from a group total.

site_definition: US dialysis clinics owned or operated by Fresenius Medical Care. The same network this spec declares as 2,600 US BRANCH sites - a clinic in the filing's words, a branch in the declaration's.

The German and British merchants showed the same STORE-beside-WAREHOUSE pairing and were excluded as divested, which hid the collision; France retains its merchants, so it surfaces here. site_definition: Volkswagen Group production plants in China. The researched 39 is the company's own total for vehicle and component plants including all joint ventures - 6 SAIC-Volkswagen and 6 FAW-Volkswagen vehicle plants among them.

site_definition: BASF production sites in Belgium. The researched 50 counts production facilities inside the Antwerp Verbund site - one integrated 6 square kilometre site, not fifty premises.

Both premises nouns in that unit are real, which is why the unit test passed it; the disqualifying word is 'within', and it sits in the unit where the label rules cannot see it. Pricing 50 PLANT archetypes asserts 50 access circuits with backup that BASF does not buy for one site. Ludwigshafen carries the identical shape at 200 production plants and stayed out only because an unrelated all-site-types exclusion happens to cover (DE, PLANT). This row was 38 of the 52 sites BASF's fresh research added.

site_definition: BASF production sites in Greater China, as the company lists them on its own key-production-sites page for the region.

site_definition: Offices of BASF India Limited, as disclosed in its own statutory filing: locations where plants, operations or offices are situated.

site_definition: A BASF campus site in Germany. The finding counts a private 5G campus NETWORK at Schwarzheide, which is a telecom deployment rather than a site.

Schwarzheide is an existing BASF German site already inside the declared estate, so promoting this adds a network deployment as though it were premises - and prices it at a campus profile. The sibling finding counts six cell masts at the same site, which is the same deployment described in hardware.

site_definition: Toyota dealerships in India - independently owned businesses selling under the Toyota brand, not Toyota premises.

site_definition: The PT Bank DBS Indonesia head office, DBS Bank Tower, Ciputra World 1, Jakarta.
note: A named address from the group's own entity listing. One site.

site_definition: Bayer campus sites in the United States. The researched 90 is an AREA in acres, not a count of campuses.
note: Two faults, either sufficient. The unit is 'acres (14 buildings, 838,000 sq ft)' - the premises word 'buildings' sits inside a parenthetical while the value counts acres, which is how it passed the unit test. And the label says disposal: Bayer is selling around 90 acres of its Creve Coeur campus. An area being sold, promoted as ninety sites.

site_definition: Warehouse sites serving Bayer Crop Science in the US. The seven are operated by GXO, a third-party logistics provider, under contract.
note: The label says it: 'GXO-operated Crop Science warehouse sites (US, 3PL)'. A 3PL warehouse is the provider's building on the provider's network - Bayer buys storage and handling, not circuits. Same basis as a franchise. Note the existing DISQUALIFYING list holds 'third-party' and did not fire, because this label says 3PL.

site_definition: The Merlin data centre at Swindon, a Capgemini-owned facility.
note: Three sources and a named, owned building. The only data centre this office-heavy case holds in the UK.

site_definition: Carrefour stores trading in Spain across every format: hypermarkets, supermarkets, convenience, cash-and-carry and Supeco.
note: The format breakdown reconciles to the total - 204 + 162 + 1,159 + 70 = 1,595 - across four sources. Worth recording that the franchise question this case was added to test did NOT arise: research returned operated-format counts rather than a franchise-inclusive network total, so there was nothing to exclude.

site_definition: Carrefour stores in Belgium: hypermarkets, supermarkets and convenience stores.
note: 40 hypermarkets, 346 supermarkets and 317 convenience stores is 703, which matches the promoted figure exactly. Three sources.

site_definition: Regional sales and service locations of E.ON Energie Deutschland GmbH.
note: Declined on two counts. The cited source says 'Das Unternehmen verfuegt ueber 28 Standorte' and the promoted figure is 30, so the number in the estate is not the number in the evidence. And the row carries no as_of at all - the undated case the staleness check reports separately, because an undated figure cannot be judged old or current. One source. The declared 0 stands.

site_definition: Avacon network operations depots in Lower Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt - staffed yards serving the regional distribution network.
note: Two sources and the depots are named individually, which is the strongest form this evidence takes. One caveat: the source listing enumerates 14 named depots and the promoted row is 15, so the fifteenth is not visible in the excerpt.

site_definition: APM Terminals container terminal sites in China: Guangzhou, Xiamen, Shanghai East, two at Tianjin and five at Qingdao.
note: Named terminal by named terminal, which is why this is verified on a single source. The caveat a reader should carry: APM Terminals holds several of its Chinese terminals through MINORITY joint-venture stakes, and the evidence does not address ownership. If the Volkswagen ruling on Chinese joint ventures is applied consistently, some of these nine are not Maersk's estate - but nothing here establishes which, so the count stands and the question is recorded.

site_definition: Woolworths Group retail stores in Australia. The researched 1,729 is the group total across Australia AND New Zealand.
note: The source says it plainly: 'total store network comprised 1,729 retail stores across Australia and New Zealand'. A two-country total promoted into one country, the same shape as BASF's North American total promoted as a US one. A sibling finding gives Australian Food at 1,130 including Metro, so the declaration is corrected to 1,130 rather than left at my round 1,100.

site_definition: Woolworths data centre facilities in Australia - computing sites, distinct from the distribution centres counted as WAREHOUSE.
note: The evidence conflates two different things under the letters DC. One finding describes a private cloud across two data centre facilities in Sydney; another describes two new Moorebank DISTRIBUTION centres, which are warehouses. The promoted 3 mixes them. The declared 2 matches the data-centre evidence and stands.

site_definition: The New Zealand subsidiary headquarters at Favona, Auckland.
note: A named address, two sources. One site.

site_definition: Carrefour stores trading in Brazil across every format: hypermarkets, supermarkets, convenience, cash-and-carry (Atacadao) and Sam's Club.
note: My declared 1,000 was a round apportionment of a group total and is corrected to 718, which the source gives as a format breakdown reconciling exactly: 108 + 26 + 141 + 385 + 58. Research found it but did not promote it, so nothing superseded the declaration and the apportioned figure would have stood 39% above the only count anybody published.

site_definition: Capgemini offices in France, enumerated from the company's own location finder: Issy-les-Moulineaux (HQ), Meudon, three Paris addresses, La Rochelle, Lons, Nantes, Trignac and others.
note: Corrected from my apportioned 30 to the ten offices the company lists. The caveat worth carrying: a location finder enumerates offices of every size, so 10 is what Capgemini publishes rather than a count of sites large enough to be LARGE_OFFICE. For an office-only estate that distinction moves the whole baseline, which is why this case was added.

site_definition: Capgemini offices in Germany, enumerated from the same location finder - Aalen, Bad Homburg, Berlin, Bremen, Donauwoerth, Dortmund, Erfurt, Floeha, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Hannover, Lehre, Luebeck, Marktoberdorf and others.
note: The one direction that went the other way: research found MORE than I declared, twenty named German offices against my apportioned ten, so the correction raises the estate rather than cutting it. Same location-finder caveat as France.

site_definition: Capgemini offices in the United Kingdom, taken from its ISO 14001 certified site list: Inverness, Birmingham, Sale, Sheffield, Swindon, Glasgow, three at Telford and Nairn.
note: Corrected from my apportioned 12 to the ten sites named on the certification list. A certified-sites list is a stronger basis than a location finder because certification is audited, but it covers only sites in scope for the certificate - so this too may understate.
